summary: Iteration 26 - Campaign-aware bill processing + PWA install banner/guide verified. All 15 backend tests pass. Frontend PWA banner + modal + drawer install-app menu fully functional end-to-end. Admin Campaigns UI renders and existing campaigns list intact.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate campaign helper: /app/backend/server.py::apply_campaign_bonus and /app/backend/routes/consumer.py::_apply_campaign_bonus_local are two copies of nearly the same logic. If one is edited without the other, campaign application will diverge between the two bill-processing paths (server.py::process_bill and routes/consumer.py). Consider extracting into /app/backend/utils/campaigns.py and importing in both.

/api/admin/campaigns/active in server.py uses raw string comparison on start_date/end_date without the length-10 padding that /api/consumer/campaigns/active applies. If a campaign is stored with a date-only string (e.g. '2026-01-01') and the current time is '2026-01-01T14:00:00Z', server-side query {end_date: {$gte: '2026-01-01T14:00:00...'}} will incorrectly exclude a campaign ending today. Consumer route pads with 'T23:59:59'; admin route should too.
Persistent React warning on consumer pages: 'Encountered two children with the same key' (source not from this iteration but visible in console) — worth fixing for stability.

Persistent React warning: 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute' — likely a home banner rendering empty src; causes browser to re-request the page URL. Should render null or omit img when src is empty.
server.py is 7176 lines — the campaign CRUD block (~100 lines) is a clean candidate to split into /app/backend/routes/admin_campaigns.py.

context_for_next_testing_agent: PWA install banner has 3.5s delay after mount; wait >4s before asserting visibility. Banner only shows when localStorage['cp67_install_banner_v1'] is unset AND not in standalone display mode. localStorage.clear() during test will also wipe consumer JWT — use page.evaluate("localStorage.removeItem('cp67_install_banner_v1')") instead if you want to reset only the dismiss flag. Home page hamburger has data-testid='menu-btn'. Existing pre-iteration console warnings ('duplicate keys', 'empty src') are noise from other pages, not from PWA components.
